metadata.title: Colorado Corrections and Victims Legislative Master List — Governor Action Update
metadata.coverage: 18 initial records; 2016–2026 full project not yet completed
metadata.governor_action: Signed vs vetoed vs no gubernatorial action; separate from effective date
metadata.note: No automatic-law-without-signature cases identified in these 18 records. Blank effective dates are intentionally not inferred.

bills.title: Rights for Victims of Certain Crimes
bills.summary: Amends the Victim Rights Act, including representative restrictions, notification rights, use of preferred names and participation in restitution assessment hearings.

bills.title: Youthful Offender System Updates
bills.summary: Updates the DOC youthful offender system with added trauma-informed programming, individualized support and procedural protections.

bills.title: Inmate Earned Time Formula for Sentence to Department of Corrections
bills.summary: Increases certain earned-time monthly allowances and establishes additional earned-time opportunities and a DOC capacity-management working group.

bills.title: Department of Corrections Visitation Rights
bills.summary: Establishes statutory social-visitation rights and limits on restrictions, addresses video/family-event visits, and provides for grievance and SMART Act reporting.

bills.title: Repeal Copayment for Department of Corrections Inmate Health Care
bills.summary: Would have eliminated DOC medical-care copayments and fees for missed or refused health-care appointments and required SMART Act reporting; vetoed by the governor.
bills.topics: CDOC; medical care; fees; SMART Act

bills.title: Protections Against Child Rape
bills.summary: Proposed mandatory prison terms for specified child sexual assault offenses and restrictions on probation; postponed indefinitely in House Judiciary.
